device.type: DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C Full HD Combo receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, Ethernet and USB PVR

device.soc: ALi M3516C / M3503 rev B (bootloader "M3516C 1.2.1", seecode "M3606 SEE", 256 MB DDR3)
device.demod: internal ALi M3503 / M3516C DVB-S2 (NIM_S3503_0) + DVB-T2/C (NIM_COFDM_0)

source.note: Archive AMIKO_MiniComboHD_SE_2.3.40_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as M3503 rev B with 256 MB DDR3 (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_minicombo_hd_se_app_starts.py, run_dump_minicombo_hd_se_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3516C 1.2.1") runs with CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF, prints "CH455 panel init OK!" and writes " ON " to the CH455 front panel on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA), parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA141A7DC, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xAE000200 and maincode(AV) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (EBase 0x80002000 / 0x8E002001).  The application prints "---led 455 attach OK--" and "hs_config_init", updates the CH455 display to " on ", populates userdb(64+64) at 0xF3FF80, and draws its 1280x720 OSD dialog on GMA layer 0 (9 GE commands, 4 colours).

desc: Amiko Mini Combo HD SE (System ID 14020A00) firmware v2.3.40 EMU (2016-01-15) on a 16 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3516C / M3503 rev B Full HD DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C Combo receiver with 256 MB DDR3.
Pairs dual-CPU M3503 maincode + seecode ("M3606 SEE" at 0xAE000200) with a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 135 / 134 (" ON " -> " on ") and a 60-entry 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
